rules: Do not use catalogue order or nearest-match defaults.
Case names in the queue (riskApproach etc.) are not stored stable keys. Resolve exact definitions and expressions through the active registry.
The current mind-catalog already permits unipolar expressions; do not force unknown opposites.
A mapping is not sufficient grounds for change: require distinct meaningful evidence, elapsed game experience, represented motive where ambiguous and controlled-player confirmation.
No universal requirement for a companion: solitary learning and decisions can be meaningful evidence when actually recorded.
Do not substitute prose promises for outcomes: asked-for help is not received help, apology not forgiveness, proposed work not completed work.
Do not apply automatic tension to every withdrawal or classify every engagement as positive.
The old scene text is inspected input, not a creative endorsement or a request to expand errands.
